headline: Broad-based category growth drives momentum

HE revenue grew 17.2% YoY, marking the third consecutive quarter of double-digit growth, led by TVs and Information Display.
Consumer preference continued to shift towards larger screens and advanced display technologies, while the B2B business strengthened as a second growth and profit engine.
Segment EBIT margins expanding 30bps to 12.9%, driven by operating leverage, higher volumes and improved B2B profitability.
